operator_assessment.operator_summary: The two Skien tournament-date repairs (JU10 rvv-0007 off the Tiger Cup collision, U11 rvv-0013 off the autumn holiday weekend) are clean: hard verification passes, no new operational/manual-placement work was introduced, and season findings counts are unchanged before/after aside from the two intended placement changes. Export formats all match the plan with zero mismatches. The season as a whole is not yet publication-ready for reasons that predate and are unrelated to today's Skien fix.

key_tradeoffs.title: JU10 Skien tournament moved to an evening slot
key_tradeoffs.summary: rvv-0007 moved from 2026-10-11 10:00 to 2026-11-21 17:00 because Skien ishall had no other legal daytime window before the Tiger Cup date without introducing new fixed-busy placement work or new temporal clustering for other clubs' JU10 teams (an earlier candidate, 2026-12-13, was rejected for exactly that reason).

key_tradeoffs.title: U11 Skien tournament moved one week later
key_tradeoffs.summary: rvv-0013 moved from 2026-10-10 to 2026-10-17 (also evening) to get it off the Telemark week-41 autumn-holiday Saturday, with zero new findings introduced.

key_tradeoffs.title: Season-wide publication readiness is unchanged and still REVIEW_REQUIRED
key_tradeoffs.summary: Deterministic publication_readiness reports publishable: false for pre-existing reasons (participation_shortfalls, external_calendar_conflicts, movable_host_confirmation_required, participation_target_deviation, tournament_placement_shortfall, hosting_balance_imbalances) that are not caused by and are out of scope for today's Skien repair.

remaining_actions.title: Resolve remaining participation shortfalls
remaining_actions.summary: 116 team/age-group participation counts remain below target across ~10 clubs; most are bounded_search_exhausted or proven_infeasible strong-goal deviations, not caused by today's change.

remaining_actions.title: Place the 12 remaining unresolved tournament obligations
remaining_actions.summary: 12 tournaments have no concrete placement yet (unplaced_tournament_placement findings); each needs its own repair-options/search pass.

remaining_actions.title: Confirm the pending Kongsberg U12 movable-ice allocation
remaining_actions.summary: rvv-0053 relies on a host-controlled 'Åpen Ishall' slot (2026-11-15) that still needs Kongsberg's confirmation.

remaining_actions.title: Resolve hosting-balance imbalances
remaining_actions.summary: 14 club/age-group hosting-balance imbalances remain outstanding season-wide.

limitations: This audit focused on verifying the two Skien repairs and cross-checking export consistency; it did not perform a fresh line-by-line review of every pre-existing participation/hosting finding across the whole season, since those are unrelated to the requested change and were already tracked before this session.
No live calendar re-scrape was performed; calendar evidence is whatever the current canonical/export state already carries.

checklist_findings.question: Antall cuper pr lag?
checklist_findings.finding: 116 team/age-group participation counts remain below their configured target across ~10 clubs (participation_shortfalls evidence), mostly classified bounded_search_exhausted or proven_infeasible strong-goal deviations. This is a pre-existing season-wide condition, unrelated to today's two Skien date moves.

checklist_findings.question: Antall hjemmeturneringer pr lag?
checklist_findings.finding: 0 unresolved hosting obligations and 0 unresolved home-representation hard failures, but 12 tournaments remain unplaced (unresolved_tournament_placements) and 14 hosting-balance imbalances are open season-wide. Both Skien home tournaments touched today (rvv-0007 JU10, rvv-0013 U11) kept their original host club and arena; only date/time changed.

checklist_findings.question: Lengde på turneringer?
checklist_findings.finding: All 178 tournaments have a consistent computed duration; the two moved tournaments were verified directly: rvv-0007 (JU10) is 140 minutes (17:00-19:20), rvv-0013 (U11) is 140 minutes (17:30-19:50) -- unchanged from their pre-move duration, only the date/start time moved. 0 blocking byes. 6 tournaments have an input-constrained shape from small registered pools (pre-existing, unrelated).

checklist_findings.question: Er det faktisk ledig tid på is?
checklist_findings.finding: 0 unresolved external calendar conflicts and 0 manual external-conflict placements at the current canonical revision. Both Skien moves were checked against the club's actual scraped Skien-ishall calendar before being applied (2026-12-13 was rejected as a candidate specifically because it wasn't legal for JU10 without new operational work; 2026-11-21 and 2026-10-17 are both real free ice windows). 1 pending host-confirmation dependency remains open (Kongsberg U12, rvv-0053, 2026-11-15 movable ice) and 38 tournaments are underfilled -- both pre-existing and unrelated to today's change.

checklist_findings.question: Deltar vertsklubben i samme turnering?
checklist_findings.finding: 0 unresolved host-participation violations season-wide. Both rvv-0007 (Skien plays in its own JU10 tournament) and rvv-0013 (Skien plays in its own U11 tournament) satisfy this after the move.

checklist_findings.question: Deltar hvert lag maksimalt én gang per dag?
checklist_findings.finding: 0 duplicate team-day entries season-wide, confirmed by deterministic hard verification (ok=true, 0 violations) at the current revision, including for the two dates touched today.

checklist_findings.question: Er det normalt maks 2 lag fra samme klubb, med 3 kun som synlig unntak?
checklist_findings.finding: 0 hard-max (3+) violations season-wide; 10 tournaments have a visible 2-team-from-one-club exception, which is the documented allowed shape. rvv-0007 has 2 Frisk Asker + 2 Jar teams; rvv-0013 has 2 Jar teams -- both within the normal 2-per-club pattern.

checklist_findings.question: Er eksportformatene konsistente?
checklist_findings.finding: CSV games/overview/team-counts, iCal and Excel row/event counts all match the plan exactly (0 mismatches) for the export generated after today's moves (export/2026-09-21T0702).

checklist_findings.question: Ser harnesset andre materielle problemer eller manglende regler vi ikke allerede har tenkt på?
checklist_findings.finding: No new rule gaps found while reviewing today's two moves. The exploration did surface one real operational nuance worth keeping in mind for future date moves at Skien: the host's fixed_busy calendar is tight enough that most weekend daytime windows are already externally booked, so a 'first fully free day' candidate (2026-12-13) still failed because it landed adjacent to another club's JU10 tournament and created new temporal_clustering findings for Frisk Asker Orange/Svart and Jar Hvit -- a reminder that a move candidate must be checked for downstream clustering on ALL participants, not only the requesting club, even when operational_acceptability and hard verification both pass cleanly.
